_method: Phrases transcribed by reading each image directly, not produced by any OCR engine or vision model. The hostile corpus used vision-model-named fragments, which biases toward vision-family readers; this corpus deliberately does not, so the engine comparison on readable screens is independent of both engines under test. Anyone can open the image and check a phrase.
